name: google-meet
title: Google Meet
description: Google Meet REST API v2 connector (past conference records). Read-only.

tools.name: google_meet_list
tools.description: List past Google Meet conference records (metadata: id, startTime, endTime, space). Pagination via pageToken.

tools.name: google_meet_get
tools.description: Get a single Google Meet conference record by id (startTime, endTime, space).

tools.name: google_meet_search
tools.description: Search past conference records (metadata only). Supports the Meet API filter expression and pagination.
